knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Messages said once often miss people who were elsewhere, so the lead repeats key points and asks for them back.
The opening describes an observed action, names the standard and asks what got in the way. Labels about character do not help the worker improve.
Repeated concerns are a signal. The lead checks them before deciding what they mean.

practicalCriteria: The learner delivers a two-minute shift briefing that a listener can repeat back accurately in their own words.
The learner gives one feedback conversation (role-play acceptable) that names an observed action, a standard and an agreed next step with a check date.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Stop and refer any concern about a safety breach to the supervisor before the feedback conversation proceeds.
Stop and refer any feedback that touches on conduct or complaints to the business's procedure.
